purpose: Bind the already-canonical Gate A merchant evaluation machinery to bounded fallback slot AWIN-02. This is preparation only and contains no real merchant evidence.

requirements.rule: There must be a Brain-accepted real runtime MCME-014 result for AWIN-01 and its terminal result must equal MERCHANT_FAIL.
Owner must supply real sanitized AWIN-02 merchant evidence from MCME-015.

assembly_rule.seed: Start from the accepted MCME-012 mapped_gate_a_record, deep-copy it, then set candidate_slot to AWIN-02 before applying only real sanitized MCME-015 merchant/downstream evidence.
assembly_rule.unknown_rule: Fields not proven by real MCME-015 sanitized evidence remain UNKNOWN/null.
assembly_rule.no_prefill_rule: Do not prefill merchant/program identity or any VERIFIED merchant/downstream evidence in PREP.

deterministic_evaluation.deterministic_requirement: Identical sanitized AWIN-02 input must yield identical evaluator output and evaluation_id on repeated evaluation.
deterministic_evaluation.evidence_digest: Canonical evaluator evaluation_id (SHA-256 canonical digest of the complete sanitized Gate A record).

reconciliation.exact_duplicate: Same AWIN-02 reconciliation_key + same evaluation_id reuses/reconciles to the existing result.
reconciliation.superseding_evidence: Same AWIN-02 reconciliation_key + changed evaluation_id appends/supersedes evidence for AWIN-02; it does not create another path.
reconciliation.cross_slot_rule: AWIN-01 evidence/result must never be reconciled into AWIN-02, and AWIN-02 evidence/result must never overwrite AWIN-01.
reconciliation.hidden_slot_rule: AWIN-03 or any additional Awin candidate slot is forbidden by bounded architecture/schema.
reconciliation.merchant_identity_binding: The first real merchant public/program identity confirmed by Owner in MCME-015 binds AWIN-02. A later different identity on AWIN-02 is a reconciliation conflict requiring Brain review, not a new merchant path.

outcome_contract.intermediate_rule: Intermediate canonical states have no terminal MCME-016 result and remain WAIT_REAL_EVIDENCE_NOT_DOD.
